digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and reconciliation framework (RP-02 BindingStore, RP-03 Jira lifecycle, RP-04 operation composition, RP-05 CLI registry, RP-06 review kernel)
propositions: RP-02 BindingStore must provide ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary where the durable tombstone, forward, and reverse identities must exactly agree; repeat is a no-op and ambiguity safety-aborts.

RP-03 outbound lifecycle must enforce maximum 3 physical Jira invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep per logical atomic operation, with scoped finite-pass fuse opening after 3 consecutive exhausted eligible outcomes across at least 2 tickets.
RP-04 operation snapshot must resolve configured > environment > project > user > default precedence, apply per-operation snapshots independently, and fail-closed on malformed config.

RP-05 CLI routing must normalize all 21 visible advanced verbs into package-data canonical help reachable before handler loading, and preserve current-run semantic exact-aliases plus backward-compatible shims.

RP-06 review-kernel must honor effective applicability with project code-review criteria evaluated against repo-relative glob matchers, require non-empty applies_to lists, and implement typed discovery trace persistence plus explicit review-plan --retry override with fresh budget and reuse of content-identical successes.

RP-06 failure policy must record failed units as coverage gaps rather than retrying same-run, skip dependency-blocked units with provenance, continue independent units, and map blocking-capable missing criteria to unsigned INDETERMINATE unless an actual blocking finding takes precedence.
